package.kup manifest parser (datpkgr ManifestParser compatible).

A kup package declares itself with a single top-level call, mirroring the config({...}) idiom:

package({
  name: "myutils",
  version: "0.1.0",
  description: "handy string helpers",
  license: "MIT",
  main: "src/myutils.kup",
  dependencies: {
    otherlib: ">= 0.2.0"
  }
})

Only name is required. version may be empty (datpkgr discovers real versions from git tags at install time). main defaults at resolution time to src/<name>.kup, falling back to <name>.kup; the raw value (when present) is kept in extra["main"]. The manifest is parsed, never evaluated: no VM runs, so this module stays threads-free and importable from unit tests under default flags.

../lang/transformers, ../lang/parser

Parse package.kup source into a datpkgr Manifest. Raises PackageManifestError (a CatchableError, safe through datpkgr) on syntax errors and on malformed declarations.
